title: Handoff record
description: The identity and continuation state of one execution as it is handed between turns. The idempotency key is what makes a retried handoff distinguishable from a new one, which matters because a retry that reads as new would double-count evidence and could exceed a limit that each half individually respected.

executionId.description: Which execution this record belongs to. The same value the evidence manifest carries, so a handoff and its evidence can be joined.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable across retries of the same logical handoff and different for a genuinely new one. A key that changed on retry would make every retry look like new work.

turn.description: Which turn this is, starting at 1.

maxTurns.description: The ceiling for this execution. That turn does not exceed maxTurns is a semantic check; JSON Schema cannot compare two sibling values (FR-28).

autonomyLevel.description: Pinned in v1, and pinned rather than defaulted. A default would be a value that applies when nothing is said, and this contract has no representation for a handoff that says nothing about its own autonomy.

scopeContractHash.description: The scope in force for this handoff. Present so a continuation cannot silently inherit a scope that changed between turns.

executionState.description: The canonical English execution states. Incomplete is distinct from failed: a run that hit a limit produced partial evidence that remains valid, while a failed one did not. Denied access is first class rather than a kind of failure, because being refused is a finding about the environment (FR-03, FR-07).

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema the instance conforms to (FR-05, FR-29).

opaqueId.description: An opaque handle, or a placeholder in the angle-bracket form that every shipped example uses. The pattern admits no path separator, no scheme and no whitespace, so a resource identifier or a URL cannot be smuggled in as an identifier.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339, UTC, Z-suffixed. The pattern is present because format is an annotation by default.

sha256Hex.description: Lowercase hex, exactly 64 characters, as ADR-0004 pins.
